department.title: Department or Topic
department.description: Optional. A department or research topic such as Marketing, Finance or Data Science, used to list faculty in that area. Leave blank when looking up a specific person.

facultyName.title: Faculty Name
facultyName.description: Name of a Gabelli faculty member: full, first or last name, a nickname like Ben, or a misspelled name. Leave blank when listing faculty by department or topic. Do not include titles like Professor or Dr.
